cohort: 65 preterm infants diagnosed with EONS and 91 preterm infants without EONS (controls)
finding: Apgar score at 5 minutes and levels of CRP, PCT, and IL-6 were independent risk factors for EONS in preterm infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be a significant factor differentiating the early-onset neonatal sepsis (EONS) group from the control group.
